stem_md: 设 $z=\ln(xy^2)$，下列偏导数计算错误的是(\quad)。
analysis_md: $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{xy^2}\cdot y^2=\frac{1}{x}，\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{xy^2}\cdot 2xy=\frac{2}{y}，\quad \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2}=-\frac{1}{x^2}，\quad \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial y^2}=-\frac{2}{y^2}，\quad \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=0$。
